# Using Video to Markdown in Claude / Claude Code

<!-- Generated by `node packages/cli build` from the harness registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

The skill is the same in every agent. This guide covers only what is specific to Claude / Claude Code.

## Install

Project scope (one repository): copy this skill folder to `.claude/skills/video-to-markdown/`.

User scope (every project): copy it to `~/.claude/skills/video-to-markdown/`.

From the gti-skills repository, the CLI does the copy for you:

```bash
node packages/cli install --harness claude --skill video-to-markdown
node packages/cli install --harness claude --skill video-to-markdown --scope user
```

Restart the agent session after installing so it rescans its skills.

## Use

Describe the task in plain language. Claude / Claude Code loads the skill when the request matches its `description`. You can also run it explicitly by typing `/video-to-markdown`.

## Where the skill finds its files

`<skill-dir>` in `SKILL.md` is the folder that contains `SKILL.md`: `.claude/skills/video-to-markdown` for a project install, or `~/.claude/skills/video-to-markdown` for a user install. Scripts and references are always addressed relative to it.

## Verify

Ask the agent which skills it has loaded and check that `video-to-markdown` is listed.

## Notes

- Nested .claude/skills folders inside subdirectories also load when working there.
- Documentation: [Claude / Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) (path source: official).
